duplicateRepairs.reason: Historical, unsigned exception recorded by the Elephant (PO decision D107): the first commit added a second registry row repeating the name and file of an existing row, the second commit removed that row again. Narrow and not extendable: it is bound to these two commits and their registry bytes, so a third commit of the same shape stays refused.
